- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.

- MUSK picks a different top class, so Normal is not independently confirmed.

2. **Regions 2, 6, 11:** Verify two-layered lobular epithelium; its spot check was 0/20.
